assumptions.global: Global factors (VIX, US policy rate, US 10-year yield, broad dollar, Brent) use FRED values for completed quarters. From 2026Q4 on (in progress on the retrieval date) the VIX and the policy rate are held at their last complete-quarter level and changes in yields, the dollar and oil are set to zero.
assumptions.domestic: Domestic drivers enter with a one-year lag from the IMF WEO: 2025 values (partly estimates) for 2026 quarters, 2026 projections for 2027 quarters.
assumptions.elections: Upcoming executive-relevant elections come from the Wikipedia 2026–2027 national electoral calendars and are not yet corroborated by a second source.
assumptions.combination: The central forecast blends the driver model, the average of the last four reported quarters and the 2015–25 country average. Weights are chosen per country group and outcome by minimising 2024–25 backtest error; interval widths come from the backtest errors at each horizon, scaled by the country's own volatility.
